_comment: Release INTENT only. Accepted product features are code (no switches). Infra identity lives in CDK / ios xcconfig and is cross-checked, not copied. Verified by scripts/release_config_gate.py (pre-deploy in CI + deploy workflows, post-deploy after cdk deploy). EMERGENCY ROLLBACK: set planner.emergency_override (e.g. "5.2") AND add a matching approved_overrides entry in the SAME reviewed PR; CDK then pins API and worker identically on every deploy until it is cleared.
